findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: products.get, sellers.listings, orders.checkoutLink, reviews.list, sellers.get, marketplace.info · Private data: orders.place, products.create, sellers.listings, offers.make, offers.respond, offers.list, orders.status, orders.list, orders.reject, orders.checkoutLink, questions.ask · Public sink: products.create, products.createFromUpload, questions.ask.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: products.get, sellers.listings, orders.checkoutLink, reviews.list, sellers.get, marketplace.info · Private data: orders.place, products.create, sellers.listings, offers.make, offers.respond, offers.list, orders.status, orders.list, orders.reject, orders.checkoutLink, questions.ask · Public sink: products.create, products.createFromUpload, questions.ask

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
